title: Simple Changes remote branches deleted outside the run
description: Sidecar beside the loop lease. Each entry binds one remote-branch reconciliation receipt, by digest, to the opening branches it records as deleted outside the run: absent from the final inventory with no merged proposal or decision that proves them obsolete, so this run never proposed or approved deleting them. The receipt records each one as deleted with classification ambiguous and a null obsoleteProof; it never counts as delivered or obsolete, and finalization reports it as needing attention. A record keeps the entry for the receipt the lease already holds beside the new one, so an interrupted record never invalidates the earlier receipt. Kept out of the lease so older clients can still read the lease.
